:::{#exr-flat-point}

#### Differentiate a quadratic

A [flat point](#def-flat-point) of a [function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-function)
is where its [derivative](calculus-derivatives.qmd#def-derivative) is zero.
The next exercises use the [parabola](algebra.qmd#def-parabola) $f(w) = w^2 - 4w + 7$
to find where $f$ is flat
and to compare a [linear approximation](calculus.qmd#eq-linear-approx)
with the exact [value](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-value).

Differentiate $f$.

:::
